simulation_type: AGENT-OPERATED USER SIMULATIONS; not human UAT

findings.user_impact: Host and Origin headers were not checked before reaching local routes. HTTP probes demonstrated acceptance; a real browser DNS-rebinding exploit or cross-origin data read was not executed.
findings.engineering_impact: Loopback binding did not establish request authority or browser origin trust.
reproduction_steps: Request /health with Host audit.invalid; POST /jobs with Origin https://audit.invalid.
findings.root_cause: Loopback binding but no request authority/origin validation before routes/body parser.
findings.confidence_evidence: source+HTTP confirmed; DNS/browser exploit not executed
findings.recommended_fix: Reject non-loopback Host and nonmatching Origin; preserve no-Origin local CLI and same-origin Studio.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Real HTTP server host/origin methods and valid local requests
findings.severity_calibration: Baseline provisional P1 narrowed to P2 because browser exploit conditions were not demonstrated. Boundary is fixed regardless.

findings.user_impact: Absolute checkout paths remain in nested draft TOML in public preview/jobs. Local privacy contract violation; no external exfiltration demonstrated.
findings.engineering_impact: Public presentation failed its embedded-string redaction contract.
reproduction_steps: Import STEP, start review, GET /jobs.
findings.root_cause: Only whole strings recognized as absolute paths; embedded TOML not redacted.
findings.recommended_fix: Reuse shared public string sanitizer for embedded paths without mutating internal request.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Nested TOML POSIX/Windows, preservation of persisted source and artifact refs
findings.verification: security-real-bootstrap-after.json: bootstrap and public job contain no absolute checkout paths; public-path-redaction tests pass

findings.user_impact: STEP features silently degrade to fallback despite real usable FreeCAD; extra process startup.
findings.engineering_impact: Real FreeCAD invocation differed from normal Python and was absent from smoke coverage.
reproduction_steps: Import canonical quality_pass_bracket.step on FreeCAD 1.1.3.
findings.root_cause: FreeCADCmd assigns __name__ to file stem; main-only guard does not execute.
findings.recommended_fix: Support explicitly invoked FreeCAD script entry while keeping module imports safe.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Run real script under FreeCAD-style run_name; normal import inert; real STEP reimport
findings.verification: step-detector-after.json; step-import-runtime.test.js: actual FreeCAD extraction and geometry handoff pass

findings.user_impact: Corrupt STEP is described as readable/ready despite failed geometry.
findings.engineering_impact: Diagnostic evidence was ignored by guided labels.
reproduction_steps: Upload truncated STEP, Check file.
findings.recommended_fix: Derive readable/partial/metadata-only/blocked/unknown presentation from existing diagnostics; preserve metadata-only fallback and safety gate.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Corrupt/missing/partial/success diagnostics render truthful state in EN/KO
findings.verification: corrupt-step-after.txt; studio-import-truth.test.js: EN/KO metadata-only and blocked states

findings.user_impact: Main Review lacks actual issues/next actions, even when JSON has them.
findings.engineering_impact: Full JSON was already downloaded, then corrupted by presentation truncation; canonical fields were not mapped.
reproduction_steps: Open a >16k review pack with prioritized_hotspots and recommended_actions.
findings.root_cause: Fetch truncates JSON before parsing; review-outputs excluded from beginner summary; schema mapping omits canonical hotspot/action fields.
findings.recommended_fix: Parse full authorized JSON and limit presentation separately; surface review issues/actions with missing-evidence truth.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Actual HTTP JSON over threshold -> parse/cards/summary; legacy compatibility
findings.performance_impact: same download size; bounded visible text
findings.verification: regression-b-review.txt: three concrete hotspots and a recommendation; >16KB HTTP artifact regression passes

findings.user_impact: Generated preview absent from history; saving is undiscoverable; home/empty history overpromise.
findings.engineering_impact: The preview/tracked split was not exposed in the primary result flow.
reproduction_steps: Default model generation then Run history.
findings.root_cause: Primary flow is preview-only; save only under advanced tools; contradictory copy.
findings.recommended_fix: Expose Save result to history from the preview, opening the existing tracked preflight and button. Clarify temporary preview versus persistent run; do not automatically submit.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Action reveals existing save preflight/control without submitting; runtime save then reopen
findings.verification: regression-a-saved-quality.txt; tracked-quality-history-after.txt; disclosure action tests pass without automatic submission

findings.user_impact: Hidden empty error alerts display during valid preflight/result.
findings.engineering_impact: CSS overrode the native hidden contract.
reproduction_steps: Generate valid example and open 3D.
findings.root_cause: Author display:flex overrides native [hidden] without an explicit hidden rule.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Real browser valid and invalid model flow
findings.verification: actual valid and invalid model flows; browser-smoke-final-quality.log

findings.user_impact: View result for primary PDF shows only generic metadata; successful primary reopen requires extra menu.
findings.engineering_impact: Capability mapping promised a specialized viewer that was not implemented.
reproduction_steps: History -> review job -> View result PDF.
findings.root_cause: PDF can_open treated as specialized viewer although none is provided.
findings.recommended_fix: Provide direct browser-safe PDF open/download within selected result, or embed approved PDF with fallback.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Capability-respecting PDF action; no HTML/private/release bundle widening
findings.verification: pdf-direct-action-after.jpg; authorized PDF HTTP 200 and Poppler render. Embedded browser reader still fails; see report limitation.

findings.user_impact: review_pack_context title obscures part identity; generic Quality result repeated 16 times.
findings.engineering_impact: Filename and generic config heuristics are being used as semantic identity.
reproduction_steps: Review multiple parts then history.
findings.root_cause: Generic config/runtime label preferred over source part; coarse taxonomy.
findings.recommended_fix: Follow-up labels from verified lineage/source metadata; keep filenames visible.
findings.verification: Requested scope completed: recorded part/revision identity and format/manifest-based grouping; EN/KO rendered two-part regressions and actual persisted result reopening passed. Browser regression for runtime.fingerprint fixed without weakening assertions. Generic labels on some legacy review sidecars remain.

findings.user_impact: 33 raw examples including intentional failures/probes; mixed Korean/English drawing guidance and banner.
findings.engineering_impact: Example discovery and legacy strings bypass curated entry points and some locale keys.
reproduction_steps: Inspect example chooser, drawing empty state and completion notice in Korean.
findings.root_cause: Uncurated examples and legacy copy outside shared keys.
findings.recommended_fix: Defer broader content curation; record as follow-up rather than silently removing examples.
findings.verification: Observed baseline behavior remains; see deferred scope in report.

findings.user_impact: Large workspace modules and source-text tests allow runtime-specific/semantic defects to escape green tests.
findings.engineering_impact: Large modules and source-regex checks increase the cost of changing behavior; size alone does not prove a defect.
observed_evidence: workspaces.js 3795 lines; artifact workspace 2753; default tests pass; browser/manual defects reproduced
reproduction_steps: Compare green npm test with runtime imports and summary flow.
findings.root_cause: Some checks match source regex instead of user-visible behavior; runtime smoke omits STEP feature detector.
findings.confidence_evidence: measured risk, no blanket quality claim
findings.recommended_fix: Add behavioral regressions at changed boundaries; defer broad decomposition.
findings.verification: Behavioral and real-runtime tests added at the changed boundaries; module decomposition deferred.

findings.user_impact: Valid imported geometry could be handed to downstream analysis with zero dimensions or zero body count.
findings.engineering_impact: STEP feature results and FCStd inspect results did not propagate canonical measured metadata.
reproduction_steps: Import quality_pass_bracket.step; inspect dimensions downstream.
Import an actual FreeCAD box FCStd; compare reported bodies with inspected solids.
findings.root_cause: model_metadata was omitted from the feature payload and inspect fallback adapters; body_count stayed at its zero default.
findings.confidence_evidence: Real FreeCAD and regression assertions reproduced the mismatch.
findings.recommended_fix: Pass measured metadata and solid count; preserve conservative metadata_only_fallback labeling.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Real STEP dimensions/volume/body check; FCStd fallback unit assertion and actual FCStd reimport.
findings.verification: STEP: one body, 160 x 100 x 8 mm; FCStd: one body, 40 x 20 x 8 mm.

findings.user_impact: Closing a drawer returned focus to a partly off-screen toggle.
findings.engineering_impact: Focus and scroll restoration were not coordinated.
reproduction_steps: At a 320px viewport, open and close Jobs/Log drawer; check focused toggle rectangle.
findings.root_cause: Focus restoration could leave the toggle top at -0.375px.
findings.confidence_evidence: Strict CDP browser assertion failed; repaired assertion passes.
findings.recommended_fix: Scroll the restored focused control into view.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Keep viewport containment assertion; add rectangle diagnostics.
findings.verification: Final CDP browser smoke passes; containment assertion not weakened.

findings.user_impact: Long recommendations ran off the page, and content beyond fixed text/line limits was omitted.
findings.engineering_impact: Both Matplotlib and fallback PDF renderers used fixed single-page layouts.
reproduction_steps: Generate/open the review pack PDF from the imported bracket.
Generate a long review with a final missing-physical-evidence marker.
findings.confidence_evidence: PDF render and extracted text reproduced truncation.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap and paginate complete content in both existing renderers.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Check first/last long-content markers in fallback and native Matplotlib; render actual report pages.
findings.performance_impact: Larger complete PDFs: observed one-page 30431 bytes became two-page 33591 bytes for the same review text.
findings.verification: Both actual pages inspected; native Matplotlib nine-page stress document retained final evidence warning.

findings.persona_scenario: Beginner / returning operator saving a model
findings.user_impact: Tracked create had no quality artifact while the corresponding CLI create performed round-trip checks.
findings.engineering_impact: CLI/Studio create orchestration diverged despite a shared quality service.
reproduction_steps: Generate quality_pass_bracket in Studio.
Save to history and inspect quality and files.
findings.root_cause: Tracked create returned createModel directly and never called generateCreateQualityArtifact.
findings.confidence_evidence: Actual saved run, real runtime integration, and source confirmed.
findings.recommended_fix: Reuse the shipped quality generator and manifest helper; display quality independently from execution/readiness.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Real reimport JSON exposed through authorized artifact route; wrong-hole fixture fails quality while job succeeds; frontend readiness remains Unknown.
findings.performance_impact: Three-run tracked median increased 422.562 to 872.381ms with real STEP/STL checks; 50ms polling resolution.
findings.verification: Real API integration and Studio history show distinct success/quality pass or fail. The artifact detail shows blocking reasons and switches EN/KO while cached. Wrong diameter: generated and reimported 8mm versus expected 6mm.

findings.user_impact: Warm health checks take much longer than ordinary local job/list requests.
findings.engineering_impact: Runtime diagnostics perform synchronous probing in the request path.
reproduction_steps: Issue repeated GET /health versus GET /jobs on a warm local server.
findings.root_cause: Synchronous runtime diagnostic probe on health requests; source tracing confirms blocking calls.
findings.confidence_evidence: Repeated HTTP timings and source; multi-client event-loop saturation not measured.
findings.recommended_fix: Measure an async or coalesced probe with explicit freshness/invalidation semantics before caching runtime availability.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Fresh, missing, changed and temporarily failed runtime must never show stale Ready.
findings.verification: Synchronous probes moved to a worker; concurrent probes coalesce, completed diagnostics are never cached. Fresh discovery, failed probe response, crash/exit/timeout/retry/disposal tests passed. Real jobs-under-health median 432.254 -> 11.246 ms; controlled comparison 887.593 -> 19.782 ms. Standalone health latency increased (54.442 -> 96.279 ms live, 74.006 -> 117.068 ms controlled); no standalone speedup claimed.

findings.user_impact: Saved STEP primary action shows generic file metadata; the interactive 3D viewer is available in the original preview workflow.
findings.engineering_impact: Tracked artifact capabilities and temporary viewport assets have different lifetime and authorization contracts.
reproduction_steps: Save model, return through history, choose the STEP primary result.
findings.root_cause: No dedicated tracked STEP/mesh viewer is registered.
findings.confidence_evidence: Observed UI; no claim that CAD bytes are invalid.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a scoped authorized tracked-model viewer using explicit artifact bindings and supported conversion/cache lifecycle.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Valid/replaced/deleted artifact, job ownership, restart, viewport fallback, and Korean/English.
findings.performance_impact: Not measured; conversion cost and cache policy need design.
findings.verification: Authorized saved STEP/STL 3D reopening verified in the real browser for two shapes, EN/KO, rotate/scroll/Fit and server restart. Real FreeCAD converted STEP/STP/BREP/BRP; authority, source changes/deletion, cache, stale-response and disposal tests passed. Missing runtime is visible, while existing STL still renders. Original source/quality hashes unchanged.

findings.user_impact: One observed Home navigation was followed by navigation back to artifacts; the intended page had to be selected again.
findings.engineering_impact: Possible interaction among restore selection, job monitoring, and navigation timing.
reproduction_steps: Reload a selected old result; immediately choose Home while other local runs complete.
findings.root_cause: Not isolated; do not assign a definitive cause from one observation.
findings.confidence_evidence: Observed once, not independently reproduced; hypothesis about mechanism.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture a deterministic navigation/monitoring regression before altering automatic navigation.
findings.regression_test_requirement: Refresh, new job in another client, user-chosen navigation and completion must have explicit ownership.
findings.verification: No data loss observed; no speculative fix.
